title: pithecellobium trapezifolium
intro: Pithecellobium trapezifolium, commonly known as the "Cedro", is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is a tropical tree native to Central America, valued for its medicinal properties and uses. The Cedro tree has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pithecellobium trapezifolium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits.
